metadata.description: zOne Playground: Claude Code plugins for zOne work. Plan and build features against the real code, review and test them with Playwright. Describe what you need, and the tools read the code, do the work and show you the evidence.

plugins.name: ztest
plugins.description: zOne QA and Playwright E2E testing: review a feature's code and audit its live UI in the browser with a team of tester agents, including the ui-auditor agent, and fix the bugs found by severity (/ztest:qa); design, write and run a Playwright suite for a feature (/ztest:feature); run an existing suite, fix test defects and rerun (/ztest:e2e). Every run ends in a PDF report.

plugins.name: zdev
plugins.description: zOne feature development: plan a feature with you against the real code on Opus (read-only investigation, impact analysis, open questions, a reviewed plan) save the confirmed plan to the D: drive folder Claude Implementation Plans, and build it after you approve, in this session or a fresh session on Sonnet or Opus (/zdev:plan); draft a Technical Requirement Document with you from your docs and the code, revise it until you accept, and export a styled DOCX (/zdev:new-trd); add a new Custom Report data source as SQL migrations (/zdev:new-report); create or update the pull request with the right target branch, linked bugs and tasks, a clean title and description and a Depended PR tag when needed (/zdev:pr).
